extensionDescription.message: Export a complete ChatGPT conversation from its link to PDF or offline HTML, with a question index.

actionTitle.message: Enter a ChatGPT link to export the full conversation as PDF / HTML

exportDescription.message: Enter a conversation link to create a PDF or a single HTML file with a question index.

sessionHint.message: Private conversations use your ChatGPT login session in this browser. Only the selected branch is read, including all its user and assistant messages from beginning to end.

showBackLinks.message: Show links back to the question index

loadTimeout.message: Page loading timed out. Check your login session and try again.

progressLayout.message: Formatting and creating the question index…

readFullFailed.message: Could not read the full conversation.

readVerified.message: Full message chain and rendered counts verified: $count$ messages, $questions$ questions. $next$

assetProblems.message: $count$ attachments could not be fully displayed; see the notes in the document.

readyOutput.message: Ready to save as HTML or PDF.

htmlSaved.message: Offline HTML created with a question index, styles and math fonts. Check Chrome downloads.

invalidUrl.message: Enter an HTTPS conversation link on chatgpt.com.

homepageUrl.message: Use a ChatGPT conversation or shared conversation link, not the homepage.

dataStructureChanged.message: The conversation data structure has changed; completeness could not be verified. No incomplete file was generated.

pagedData.message: The server returned a paginated fragment; completeness could not be verified. No incomplete file was generated.

ambiguousBranch.message: Could not identify the selected conversation branch. No file was generated.

incompleteChain.message: The message chain is incomplete or contains a cycle. No file was generated.

generating.message: The conversation is still being generated. Wait for the response to finish before exporting.

noMessages.message: This conversation has no user or assistant messages to export.

assetTooLarge.message: The attachment is too large to embed in a single HTML file

unsupportedComponent.message: This component could not be fully converted to static HTML

missingAssetId.message: The attachment has no download identifier

conversationMismatch.message: The reading page no longer matches the requested conversation link. Try again.

readAccessFailed.message: Could not read the full conversation (HTTP $status$). Sign in to ChatGPT in this browser and confirm you can access the link.

readHttpFailed.message: Could not read the full conversation (HTTP $status$). Try again later.

countMismatch.message: Message count verification failed. No file was generated.

assetDisplayFailed.message: This attachment could not be displayed as HTML

renderMismatch.message: Rendered counts do not match the full message list. No file was generated.

pdfOutlineHint.message: For an existing PDF without sidebar bookmarks, select its conversation here, then use Add PDF sidebar index to choose the file. Manual printing also needs this step; Export → PDF adds bookmarks automatically.

pdfOutlineSaved.message: Created a PDF with $questions$ question bookmarks and $pages$ pages. Open the new file and select Bookmarks in the PDF sidebar.

pdfOutlineFailed.message: Could not add PDF sidebar bookmarks: $error$

pdfSourceMismatch.message: Choose the PDF saved from the conversation currently shown here. Its original conversation link is missing or does not match.

pdfQuestionMismatch.message: PDF question destinations do not match the current conversation. Save all pages of the current export using Chrome’s Save as PDF, then try again.

pdfDestinationsInvalid.message: The PDF has invalid or missing page destinations. Save it again using Chrome’s Save as PDF with all pages selected.

pdfTooLarge.message: Select a PDF no larger than 100 MiB.

pdfEncrypted.message: Encrypted PDFs are not supported. Choose the unencrypted PDF saved by Chrome.

pdfInvalid.message: Could not read this PDF. Choose a valid PDF saved by Chrome.

directPdfHint.message: Export → PDF creates sidebar bookmarks automatically, using the selected orientation and return-link setting. Chrome may show a debugging notice during export; the connection ends when rendering finishes.

directPdfProgress.message: Generating a PDF locally with the selected page settings…

directPdfSaved.message: PDF exported with $questions$ question bookmarks and $pages$ pages. Check Chrome downloads.

directPdfFailed.message: Could not export PDF: $error$ You can use the printing options under More options.

pdfExportBusy.message: A PDF export is already in progress.

pdfDebuggerRequired.message: Reload the updated extension and accept Chrome’s debugger permission.

pdfExportWrongPage.message: Direct PDF export is available only from this extension’s export tab.

pdfExportNoData.message: Chrome did not return a complete PDF. Please retry.
